verdict.rationale: Buzz documents in-app voice huddles: users and agents can "drop into voice huddles", and the relay "also hosts git + huddle audio", so audio calls live inside the product. A VISION line reading "1:1 and group. Up to 9." hints at DM and group calling, but its context is ambiguous. Missing for 10: any evidence of video calls (the video item is playback with comments, not calling), explicit documentation of starting a call from a channel or DM, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
